{{Top|leg}}
The '''KC5 capacitor component''' was produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The KC5 used enhanced field stabilization technology and precision targeting algorithms to increase a ship's primary weapon range.
